purpose: Adapters for five strict nineteenth-century microscope-slide collection nodes recovered through current institutional collection pages, historical collection catalogues and institutional research publications.
guards: Do not project mixed-period current repository totals wholly into the nineteenth century; preserve explicit nineteenth-century formation evidence separately from later accumulation.
Keep sample, specimen, slide and current stable-identifier counts in separate namespaces; do not convert sample numbers into slide counts.
A present institutional arrangement may combine material from several historical custody strata; preserve deposit, transfer, permanent loan, later accession and present holding as distinct events.
Historical labels or names on slides do not by themselves prove preparation by the named person; preserve preparation, use, ownership and custody as separate relations.
Approximate collection-scale terms such as 'hundreds', 'large collection' and 'about 300' remain approximate until a register or item-level enumeration is recovered.

adapters.institution_scope: Naturhistorisches Museum Wien Herbarium W Albert Grunow diatom collection
adapters.target: official NHM Vienna Grunow digitisation page, catalogue/sample numbering systems and JACQ stable identifiers
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest explicit sample numbers, slide references, preparation type and current QR/JACQ identifiers when exposed; keep 3,278 catalogue sample numbers distinct from the approximately 1,400 extant Grunow slides.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh G.A. Walker Arnott diatom slides and unmounted material
adapters.target: RBGE current diatom collection page plus Algae World photographed catalogues for Large and Small tube sequences
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture Large-tube and S-prefixed Small-tube sample/slide numbering, label metadata and historical correspondents; preserve Glasgow to Scottish Marine Biological Association to RBGE permanent-loan custody separately from original Arnott collection formation.

adapters.institution_scope: Sedgwick Museum of Earth Sciences Igneous and Metamorphic Petrology Harker Collection
adapters.target: current Sedgwick petrology collection page, institutional archive/catalogue and Virtual Microscope Harker history
adapters.promotion_rule: Use explicit nineteenth-century Harker dates and specimen/slide records for CORE_19C; treat current 160,000 hand specimens and 250,000 thin sections as mixed-period repository totals and leave the nineteenth-century thin-section subtotal unresolved.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Oxford Sir William Dunn School of Pathology Percy Temple Sutcliffe / James Ritchie early teaching slides
adapters.target: institutional Fusion newsletter PDF documenting 1897 practical pathology teaching and the rediscovered Sutcliffe slide collection
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the explicit 1897 practical-teaching context, approximately 300-slide rediscovery and label phrases; do not assert that every slide was made in 1897 or personally prepared by Ritchie without item-level dates or maker evidence.

adapters.institution_scope: British Geological Survey Joseph D. Hooker unregistered fossil-plant thin-section collection
adapters.target: BGS Earthwise collection page and its full list of P-numbered thin sections
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest P-numbered examples, locality, collector/preparer statements and dates; keep the collection-scale 'hundreds' approximate and distinguish Hooker assembly, Nicol preparation, Darwin-Hooker exchange and current BGS registration.
